notes.title: Update v0.10.1
notes.content:
Update v0.10.1 [2020-03-01]
     Player values and wage demands rebalanced
     Match Incident icons added to the Match Report layout
     Fixed Match Incident icons appearing on the lineup tab slightly before they were appearing on the timeline.  They now appear on both at exactly the same time
     Fixed Match Incident icons not being shown for players who were substituted off during a match
     Fixed a bug whereby condition for a player who was substituted off could show as zero during the match, if the user disconnected then reconnected during the match
     Fixed national team squad numbers appearing incorrectly on the national team squad layout
     During the end of season, if a club doesn't have enough players to field a squad (senior, U21 or U18) they have, they will be signed some players for free to ensure they do have enough players
     Default layout updated

Match Engine changes:
     Added home team advantage (note: doesn't apply to cup KO round matches).  Away team's players now lose up to 1 attribute point per attribute (depending on each player's Teamwork attribute)
     Added player attribute Teamwork (outfielders and GK's.  Teamwork is no longer tied to Workrate):  A player's ability to play to the best of their ability in away matches.  (1 in Teamwork means each of that player's attributes is reduced by 1.  20 in Teamwork means no attribute reduction at all and player plays just as well away from home than they do at home.  2-19 in Teamwork scales between 1 and 0 attribute reduction)
     Added player attribute Flair (outfield players only): A player's ability to do unexpected things and draw fouls from opposition players whilst they are dribbling the ball.
     Anticipation (GK's only) attribute added.  How well a goalkeeper can anticipate through balls and 'rush out' to claim the ball for themselves.
     Composure (GK's only) attribute added (Composure is no longer tied to Technique for Keepers).  The ability of a goalkeeper to catch the ball as opposed to just deflect it when unexpected things happen (such as the ball taking a deflection off another player or hitting the woodwork).
     Attributes that reduce other attributes are no longer subject to reductions for any reason (i.e. condition loss, playing out of position, playing away).  These attributes are: Teamwork, Endurance, Natural Fitness, Injury Proneness.  This is to prevent attribute losses 'compounding' on each other.
     Improvements to positioning behaviour of players, especially those assigned with Mixed mentality
     Improvements to dribbling behaviour of players
     Improvements to passing behaviour of players (less very short passes, improvements to long balls, through balls and crossing)
     Improvements to offside handling (Sometimes players were offside and 'getting away' with it)
     Balancing changes to shooting from set pieces (players are now a little worse at shooting from direct free kicks or penalties)
     Corner taking ability of players rebalanced (good players are now better, bad players are unchanged) i.e. players who are good at taking corners are now better at taking corners than they were before
     First Touch (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are now much better, bad players are now much better) i.e. all players are now much better when taking their first touch to control the ball
     Jumping/Strength (outfielders) attributes rebalanced (good players are now a little better, bad players are now a little worse) i.e. these attributes are now a little more important generally to be able to win headers
     Marking attribute rebalanced (good players are unchanged, bad players are now worse) i.e. players with low marking are now worse at marking opponents
     Vision (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are now much better, bad players are now a little better) i.e. better ability to see openings for potential passes across the board, but especially for players that are high in Vision
     Crossing attribute rebalanced (good players are now much better, bad players are now a little better) i.e. better quality of crossing across the board, but especially for players that are high in Crossing
     Reading of Game (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players now a little better, bad players are now a little worse) i.e. this attribute is now more important across the board
     Off the Ball (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players now a little better, bad players are now a little worse) i.e. this attribute is now more important across the board
     Finishing & Long Shots (outfielders) attributes rebalanced (good players are now a little better at shooting in normal play, bad players are now a little better at shooting in normal play) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board
     Composure (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are now better at performing in critical defensive situations, bad players are now better at performing in critical defensive situations) i.e. this attribute is now more important (defensively) across the board
     Tenacity (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are unchanged, bad players are now a little better) i.e. players with low tenacity are now a little more likely to get stuck in to attempt to make tackles 
     Technique (GK's) attribute rebalanced (good players are unchanged, bad players are now better) i.e. bad technique keepers are now better to parrying shots
     Reflexes (GK's) attribute rebalanced (good players are now better, bad players are now better) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board
     Agility/Balance (GK's) attributes rebalanced (good players are now better, bad players are now better) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board
     Jumping/Strength (GK's) attributes rebalanced (good players are now a little better, bad players are now a little better) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board
     Balancing changes to player match rating/10 system
     Fixed full time whistle not blowing at full time if there was a penalty shootout to follow
     Various stability improvements/fixes

* Please note regarding all the above attribute balancing changes:  Only those tagged as 'much better/worse' are likely to be noticeable to the human eye (and only to the very observant).  The rest, especially those tagged as 'little better/worse' are almost certainly not noticeable to the human eye and only apparent in a meaningful way when analysing large volumes of match results.

notes.title: Update v0.10.0 - New 2D Match Engine
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that the new 2D Match Engine has been added to the game.  All matches in 90MF are now using the new match engine!

New Match Engine Q&A: https://steamcommunity.com/app/468070/discussions/1/1741140266528049303/

Update v0.10.0 [2020-02-01]
 New 2D/visual based match engine (replacing the existing text/commentary feed based match engine)
 Added tactical option of individual player mentalities
 Added new team instruction sliders for Passing Focus, Passing Freedom, Attacking Width, Defensive Width and Engagement Line
 Added new match stats for Corners, Attacking Free Kicks and Territory
 Added formation restrictions to prevent completely unrealistic formations
 Added selection restrictions to enforce only GK's being able to play in goal and not allowing GK's to be selected in outfield positions
 Added selection restriction for substitutes bench to enforce the selecting of 1 and only 1 GK on the bench (renamed substitute slot for backup GK to be SUBGK)
 Penalty takers (and other set piece takers) are now automatically being selected based on who is best at them from the players currently on the pitch
 New injuries system (note: Physio's temporarily not having any effect in game)
 Green injuries (knocks) now lose between 5% and 20% condition based on a player's injury proneness attribute.  Recovery is now a fixed 5% per match for all players
 Condition loss system changed as to how losing condition impacts players in matches
 Players playing 'out of position' system changed as to how it impacts player in matches
 In-match tactical changes system changed.  Changes can now only be made during a pause and a pause can only be made during a stoppage in play
 Tactics now only save/update whenever changes are confirmed, any non-confirmed changes will be discarded when leaving a page (selecting players to positions will now work much faster/smoother for many users)
 Warnings now appear on the events timeline
 Added pause timer clock icons
 Overhauled entire server/networking architecture between the game client/match server/main server/etc.  We'll be much better placed to fix issues with this side of things going fowards
 Added 'Match Engine Buffer' settings option in the Other Settings, which allows users who are suffering from lag to potentially improve the quality of their gameplay experience
 Added new match summary layout
 Improved autoselect logic
 GO TO MATCH button left/right click functionality has been inverted
 Users without a Pro Membership can now request and play friendly matches
 Added latest results widget (for the entire gameworld) to the home layout
 Added button that allows you to reset your squad numbers mid-season (via the ... menu in the lineup/pitch).  Squad numbers are no longer automatically reset/updated during Season Finish
 Players now have separate squad numbers for their national teams to what they do for their club teams
 Updates to pre-match tips library
 Hidden player attributes now removed from the game
 Visible player attributes updated (note: not all attributes are doing something at present, more information can be found in the game guide)
 'REC' plate now shown for players who have less than 90% condition rather than less than 100% condition
 If a user has a youth squad and doesn't have enough players for that squad during season finishing for next season (including graduate players) then the AI will sign some free players for that user to ensure they have enough players to field a squad for matches in the next season
 Players can no longer be sold if they are currently selected in one of your squads (you must remove them from the squad selection first, then sell the player)
 Matches now can no longer be started between 23:30 and midnight daily (was previoiusly 23:40 and midnight daily)
 Various performance/stability enhancements to the codebase throughout the client and server, particularly in regards to improving the quality of the gameplay experience for those with poor ping speeds to the server and/or packet loss
 Clubs over the Hard Squad Limit of players will automatically have players sold during Season Finish in order to bring them down to the Hard Squad Limit.  The Hard Squad Limit is 70 players (any pending academy graduates or 15 year youth player purchases do not count towards this).  Players will be sold in order of least valuable to most valuable with a priority on players aged over 18 yeras old

notes.title: New Match Engine Quick Progress Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone

Just a quick update to let you know that we’re still working hard on the new match engine and have been making a lot of progress.  

We’ve had a change in approach and have completed a number of the earlier testing phases internally as we felt that more value would be added by involving users in the testing when things are more complete.

Things have ended up taking longer than we had initially hoped for a few reasons, but the progress that’s been made will be rather obvious when you see it! 

Thanks for your patience guys.  We’ll have an update with more information later this month!

Any users who were impacted by this (primarily via signing Free Agent players whose value subsequently decreased after they purchased them) have been reimbursed an amount equal to the loss in negative value difference plus the difference in wages that are also too high for the current season due to the values being too high at the time these players were purchased.  Any impacted users will be able to see the amount they have been credited back in their Finances > Transaction tab with the record listed as being of type ADJUSTMENT.  The players you own that have been significantly impacted by this can relatively easily spotted out as being the players who you've purchased during this month and whose wage demand for next season is significantly higher than their wage demand for the current season.  The few Academy that have been purchased were also significantly impacted by this same issue and those users have also been reimbursed the value differences.

 Minimum points per answer on Reborn Legends minigame changed from 1 to 0 (will only impact in case where user is just obviously entering random answers)
 Minor updates to pre-match tips library

Bug Fixes:
     TV Rights now correctly projected for new users in Qualifying Leagues
 Tweaks to TV Rights for new users


Update v0.4.1a [2018-05-24]
     Changed default layout (including U18 calendar restored)
 Chat optimisations
 National tab added to online user widget (in preparation for next season to allow national team managers to more easily find each other to play friendly matches)
 Match logging upgraded (help with improving match stability)
 Twitter boards removed (will be reworked and re-introduced)
 Last online user information on Player Profiles to be inline with player search
 Server Side Performance Optimisations


Update v0.4.1b [2018-05-25]
     Price column value on National Teams auctions widget is now blank for nations that have already been purchased


Update v0.4.1c [2018-05-30]
     National Team managers can now add players to their national squads (provided they are of the same nationality and at least 16 years of age)
 National Team managers can now remove players from their national squads
 Players who are currently in a national squad now show "Int." after the nationality of the player in their Personal Details widget
 International season stats row in the Current Season Stats widget now only shows for players who are currently in a national squad or have played any official international matches in the current season
 National Team Auctions Summary widget now shows different information when all auctions have finished (to advise users that they have finished and will start again next season)
 Other settings widget where users select which players to show progression arrows for has been improved to make more intuitive
 National Team jobs and National Team tokens are associated to Steam accounts, so:
 If a user resets their club team account they'll still have access to their National Team Tokens; and
 If a user resets their club team account and the user is currently managing a National Team, ownership of the National Team is transferred to that users new club/account; and
 If a user resets their club team account and the user has purchased a National Team for the following season, ownership of that National Team for the following season is transferred to that users new club/account


Update v0.4.1d [2018-05-31]
     Added World Cup tournament (3 stage cup competition: Qualifying stage then Group stage then Finals KO stage)
 Added World Cup layout
 Added World Cup menu item to Competitions Menu
 World Cup qualifying groups draw will be seeded starting from July 2018 World Cup qualifying campaign
 National Team Auctions Summary widget now shows seeding information
 National Team Auctions Summary widget now shows summarised information about the prices that teams went for in the previous season
 National Team Auctions Instructions widget has had instructions updated

Update v0.4.1e [2018-06-26]
     Seeding column added to National Teams widget on International Registrations layout
 Full player names on squad list now have correct capitalisation when various special characters are used in the name (such as hyphens)
 Minor updates to profanity filter
 Home colour schemes for Algeria, Saudi Arabia and Senegal updated to have a darker shade of green (commentary was too difficult to read with the lighter shade of green)

Update v0.4.1f [2018-07-12]
     Online status icon awarded to user who wins the World Cup
 The following nations are now available to manage: Cameroon, Cyprus, Gibraltar, Kosovo, Morocco, Nigeria, Peru, South Korea
 In future seasons the nations that are available to manage will be automatically determined based on the nations that have enough players owned by active users
 Server Side Performance Optimisations
 Server Side threshold for number of live concurrent matches increased

notes.title: Update 0.3.3
notes.content:
Multi-Stage Cup Competitions


Update v0.3.3 [2017-12-31]

Cup Competition Related Changes:
     Multi-stage Cup Competitions functionality added
     Group Stages can now be part of Cup Competitions
     Community Trophy Competitions now all have a group stage followed by finals knock out stage
     Sans Pareil Cup now has a qualifying round, followed by group stage, followed by finals knock out stage
     Legends Cup now has a large group stage, followed by finals knock out stage
     Sans Pareil Cup draw is now seeded
     Cup Holders' Cup draw is now seeded
     For more information on the new cup competition structures please refer to: https://isokron.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/90MF/pages/1377507/Competitions
     Cup Page Layouts updated for new multi-stage cup competitions (WIP, improvements will be made throughout January)
     Skeleton of new Group Phase league table widget for Cup Competition Group Phase Layouts (WIP, improvements will be made throughout January)
     Please note: Legends Cup will be started on 2nd January

Match Experience Changes:
     Minor improvements to match commentary
     Minor balancing changes to the match rating /10 system

Reborn Legends Minigame Changes:
     Question of the day added and is worth double points
     Improved points forumula, answering questions properly is now far more rewarding

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Bonus League Reputation now awarded for 1st (10%), 2nd (5%) and 3rd (2.5%) in each League
     Players now learn new positions faster
     On the last day of the season Youth Players now say on their profile page that they are unavailable
     Players who are retiring now indicate this is the reason why they cannot be transferred and are unavailable
     Users are now able to register accounts with characters in their steam names that are not in the UTF-8 character set or with steam names that are more than 30 characters long
     Performance optimisations to recording match data to game server after matches are completed
     Improvements to match rescheduling logic (less far in the future now)
     Fixed issue with incorrect text appearing in pop-up windows for Release from Contract and Renegotiate Contract buttons when activated during the final 24 hours of the season


Update v0.3.3a [2018-01-02]
     Legends Cup (with large group phases) started
     Wage demand fix for players who didn't renew their contracts at their contract renewal wage amounts


Update v0.3.3b [2018-01-08]
     Server side performance optimisations


Update v0.3.3c [2018-01-09]
     Fixed cup History widget not working
     Fixed chat counts not being correct in the chat channels
     Server side performance optimisations


Update v0.3.3d [2018-01-11]
     End of Day Processing performance update (should now run much faster and game be offline for much less time each day)
     Balanced player progression to ensure more rounded development of "squad" players who occasionally play official matches
     Fix for Sans Pareil Cup group stage not commencing


Update v0.3.3e [2018-01-23]
     Early Bird FA added and available for selection to start next season
     Legends Cup performance was not counting towars club reputation, this has been fixed alongside retroactively correcting historical reputation data


Update v0.3.3f [2018-01-31]

Competition Related Changes:
     Promotion and Relegation places now highlighted on league tables
     Sans Pareil Cup qualification places now highlighted on division 1 league tables
     Dates of competitions and their stages reworked, find more information here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/468070/discussions/1/1692659769966025497/
     Club name and position fields swapped in column order for group stages widget
     For the Top Average Rating widget on League Competition Pages, only include players who have played a minimum number of matches

Player/Staff Contracts Related Changes:
     Transfer Budget calculation changed to only require a user to have a positive bank balance in 28 days time
     Players can now be instantly signed after being a free agent for 3 days (formerly was 7 days)
     Staff can now be instantly signed after being a free agent for 3 days (formerly was 7 days)
     Contract Renegotiations for players removed from game
     Wage system balancing changes (slight increase for young and old players, slight decrease for players in their prime)
     Signing Fees are now only payable for transfer negotiations (and not for the initial bidder), they no longer apply at all for contract release negotiations
     Change auto-sign logic (when user doesn’t have enough players for a match) to not sign wiki players (mostly issue on beta)
     Wage code revamped to hopefully not result in any differences in various situations/places due to minor effects like rounding differences

Performance Related Changes:
     Another End of Day Processing performance update (should now be faster still and the game be offline for less time each day)
     Some very minor client performance optimisations

Match Experience Changes:
     Increased amount of knocks during matches
     Minor balancing changes to the match rating /10 system

Profanity Filter Related Changes:
     Minor profanity filter update (less strict overall)
     Profanity Filter now works correctly when drafting mail messages


Update v0.3.3g [2018-02-02]

     Staff now automatically released from clubs to become free agents at the end of a season in which the staff has spent at least 2 full seasons at a club
     Staff now no longer increase wages at the end of season when renewing contract at a club
     Reborn Legends Minigame required points threshold for Legends Cup Qualification increased from 50,000 to 100,000
     Highlighting places in group tables for cup competitions to indicate who will qualify for the next round


Update v0.3.3h [2018-02-09]

     Impose Transfer Block feature added (users can now choose to block transfer activity being allowed between themselves and specific clubs)
     Further wage system balancing changes (another slight increase for young and old players, another slight decrease for players in their prime)
     Wages now display correctly when making a transfer bid for players in the client (there were a couple of issues causing them to not display correctly)
     Issue with 16 year old players not developing properly has been fixed, and any development they have missed was retroactively given to them


Update v0.3.3i [2018-02-20]

Competition Related Changes:
     Inter-FA Cup fixtures are now scheduled in the home teams FA playtimes for group stage fixtures and the initial fixtures drawn in KO rounds
     Cup Stage Navigation arrows
     Added Cup Stage name to title bar
     Club Logos now displayed on League Tables
     Club Logos now displayed on Group Stage Tables for Cup Competitions
     Legends Cup added to Senior Trophies widget (placeholder art currently being used)
     Youth Trophies widget added to Club > Profile view (placeholder art currently being used)

Other Changes:
     Homepage Negotiations widget now shows a bespoke list of players tailored for each user rather than just those players whose negotiations are ending soonest
     Server side performance optimisations

Bug Fixes:
     Season Leaders widgets fixed on competition pages
     Legends Cup hyperlink from World > Overview layout now working
     Fixed rare bug with Current Negotiations widget on the Transfers > Negotiation View not working anymore if the GUI is customised
     Fixed rare bug where it was possible for player attributes to go down to 0/20


Update v0.3.3j [2018-02-28]

     Manager Briefing widget (informs of progress towards earning daily TV Rights, Various Squad Availability notifications, Various Staff notifications, Soft Squad Limit Exceeded notifications, Legends Cup Qualification Status, Overdue Fixture notifications, Transfer Bids Received, Negative Projected Bank Balance notification, Shareholder Dividend Payment Due at end of season notification)
     TEMPORARY NOTE: part of manager briefing widget disabled until after season finishing (for TV Rights and Shareholder Dividends)
     TV Rights now need to be earned by playing live matches against online opponents or requesting for matches during the playtimes of your FA
     Drop list amounts when making transfer bids scaled down and more incremental at the higher end
     No Trophies Won text on Trophies widgets updated to indicate whether it is for Youth or Senior trophies that have not been won
     When a player becomes a Free Agent their Most Recent Transfer Fee becomes reset to £0
     Fixed issue with Player/Staff names not appearing correctly in the client when certain 'special' characters were used (fix only applies to any new players/staff entering the game, at present the old effected ones are still effected)
     Server side performance optimisations

Match Experience Changes:
     Minor match rating /10 balancing changes (very slight buffs to defenders and GK's)
     GK Injuries occur less frequently
     Physio's have slightly more influence over preventing injuries from occurring
     Injury Resistance attribute of players has slightly more influence over preventing injuries from occurring to them (note: Injury Proneness attribute is a text description composite of both Injury Resistance and Injury Recovery
     Opponents aggression slider no longer has any bearing on the likelihood that your players could get injured
     Your own aggression slider now has more bearing on the likelihood that your own players could get injured
     Condition loss has slightly less overall negative impact on the performance level of players on the pitch (i.e. a slight nerf to backing off slider setting and high endurance players, and a slight buff to closing down slider setting and low endurance players)


Update v0.3.3k [2018-03-02]
     Manager Briefing widget now shows any Shareholder Dividend payment amount falling due at the end of the season
     Fixed TV Rights payments not being shown correctly in the Manager Briefing widget
     Note: TV Rights are making standard payments whilst we fix the issue of them not being processed correctly (once we've confirmed it's been fixed, we will correct any previously recorded incorrect data)
     Fixed cup competition logos and colour schemes not displaying
     Server side performance optimisations


Update v0.3.3l [2018-03-08]
     Shareholder Dividend Payments can now be seen in the projected transactions list on the finances page
     Shareholder Dividend Payments now appear on the 28 Day Projection table widget
     Shareholder Dividend Payments Threshold line now appears on the Finances Chart
     Prize Money is now paid out at the beginning of the following season rather than the end of the current season (so it won't be included as part of the Shareholder Dividend Payment calculation at the end of the current season)
     From midnight after release, TV Rights are now only projecting according to the percentages listed here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/468070/discussions/1/3377008022032648035/
     Auto-GUI rescaling on first login for new users, to ensure everything will fit properly if they don't have a resolution that is 1920 x 1080 or higher
     Various fixes to historical player stats records for clubs and competitions not showing correctly
     Trophies widgets will now scroll if user has too many different trophies to fit in the available space
     Manager Briefing messages related to U18 and U21 squads now reworded to make clearer
     Date format of financial transactions now YYYY-MM-DD (rather than US Date format)
     Server side performance optimisations

     Cup Holders' Cup draw is now seeded
     For more information on the new cup competition structures please refer to: https://isokron.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/90MF/pages/1377507/Competitions
     Cup Page Layouts updated for new multi-stage cup competitions (WIP, improvements will be made throughout January)
     Skeleton of new Group Phase league table widget for Cup Competition Group Phase Layouts (WIP, improvements will be made throughout January)
     Please note: Legends Cup will be started on 2nd January

Match Experience Changes:
     Minor improvements to match commentary
     Minor balancing changes to the match rating /10 system

Reborn Legends Minigame Changes:
     Question of the day added and is worth double points
     Improved points forumula, answering questions properly is now far more rewarding

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Bonus League Reputation now awarded for 1st (10%), 2nd (5%) and 3rd (2.5%) in each League
     Players now learn new positions faster
     On the last day of the season Youth Players now say on their profile page that they are unavailable
     Players who are retiring now indicate this is the reason why they cannot be transferred and are unavailable
     Users are now able to register accounts with characters in their steam names that are not in the UTF-8 character set or with steam names that are more than 30 characters long
     Performance optimisations to recording match data to game server after matches are completed
     Improvements to match rescheduling logic (less far in the future now)
     Fixed issue with incorrect text appearing in pop-up windows for Release from Contract and Renegotiate Contract buttons when activated during the final 24 hours of the season


Update v0.3.3a [2018-01-02]
     Legends Cup (with large group phases) started
     Wage demand fix for players who didn't renew their contracts at their contract renewal wage amounts


Update v0.3.3b [2018-01-08]
     Server side performance optimisations


Update v0.3.3c [2018-01-09]
     Fixed cup History widget not working
     Fixed chat counts not being correct in the chat channels
     Server side performance optimisations


Update v0.3.3d [2018-01-11]
     End of Day Processing performance update (should now run much faster and game be offline for much less time each day)
     Balanced player progression to ensure more rounded development of "squad" players who occasionally play official matches
     Fix for Sans Pareil Cup group stage not commencing


Update v0.3.3e [2018-01-23]
     Early Bird FA added and available for selection to start next season
     Legends Cup performance was not counting towars club reputation, this has been fixed alongside retroactively correcting historical reputation data


Update v0.3.3f [2018-01-31]

Competition Related Changes:
     Promotion and Relegation places now highlighted on league tables
     Sans Pareil Cup qualification places now highlighted on division 1 league tables
     Dates of competitions and their stages reworked, find more information here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/468070/discussions/1/1692659769966025497/
     Club name and position fields swapped in column order for group stages widget
     For the Top Average Rating widget on League Competition Pages, only include players who have played a minimum number of matches

Player/Staff Contracts Related Changes:
     Transfer Budget calculation changed to only require a user to have a positive bank balance in 28 days time
     Players can now be instantly signed after being a free agent for 3 days (formerly was 7 days)
     Staff can now be instantly signed after being a free agent for 3 days (formerly was 7 days)
     Contract Renegotiations for players removed from game
     Wage system balancing changes (slight increase for young and old players, slight decrease for players in their prime)
     Signing Fees are now only payable for transfer negotiations (and not for the initial bidder), they no longer apply at all for contract release negotiations
     Change auto-sign logic (when user doesn’t have enough players for a match) to not sign wiki players (mostly issue on beta)
     Wage code revamped to hopefully not result in any differences in various situations/places due to minor effects like rounding differences

Performance Related Changes:
     Another End of Day Processing performance update (should now be faster still and the game be offline for less time each day)
     Some very minor client performance optimisations

Match Experience Changes:
     Increased amount of knocks during matches
     Minor balancing changes to the match rating /10 system

Profanity Filter Related Changes:
     Minor profanity filter update (less strict overall)
     Profanity Filter now works correctly when drafting mail messages


Update v0.3.3g [2018-02-02]

     Staff now automatically released from clubs to become free agents at the end of a season in which the staff has spent at least 2 full seasons at a club
     Staff now no longer increase wages at the end of season when renewing contract at a club
     Reborn Legends Minigame required points threshold for Legends Cup Qualification increased from 50,000 to 100,000
     Highlighting places in group tables for cup competitions to indicate who will qualify for the next round


Update v0.3.3h [2018-02-09]

     Impose Transfer Block feature added (users can now choose to block transfer activity being allowed between themselves and specific clubs)
     Further wage system balancing changes (another slight increase for young and old players, another slight decrease for players in their prime)
     Wages now display correctly when making a transfer bid for players in the client (there were a couple of issues causing them to not display correctly)
     Issue with 16 year old players not developing properly has been fixed, and any development they have missed was retroactively given to them


Update v0.3.3i [2018-02-20]

Competition Related Changes:
     Inter-FA Cup fixtures are now scheduled in the home teams FA playtimes for group stage fixtures and the initial fixtures drawn in KO rounds
     Cup Stage Navigation arrows
     Added Cup Stage name to title bar
     Club Logos now displayed on League Tables
     Club Logos now displayed on Group Stage Tables for Cup Competitions
     Legends Cup added to Senior Trophies widget (placeholder art currently being used)
     Youth Trophies widget added to Club > Profile view (placeholder art currently being used)

Other Changes:
     Homepage Negotiations widget now shows a bespoke list of players tailored for each user rather than just those players whose negotiations are ending soonest
     Server side performance optimisations

Bug Fixes:
     Season Leaders widgets fixed on competition pages
     Legends Cup hyperlink from World > Overview layout now working
     Fixed rare bug with Current Negotiations widget on the Transfers > Negotiation View not working anymore if the GUI is customised
     Fixed rare bug where it was possible for player attributes to go down to 0/20


Update v0.3.3j [2018-02-28]

     Manager Briefing widget (informs of progress towards earning daily TV Rights, Various Squad Availability notifications, Various Staff notifications, Soft Squad Limit Exceeded notifications, Legends Cup Qualification Status, Overdue Fixture notifications, Transfer Bids Received, Negative Projected Bank Balance notification, Shareholder Dividend Payment Due at end of season notification)
     TEMPORARY NOTE: part of manager briefing widget disabled until after season finishing (for TV Rights and Shareholder Dividends)
     TV Rights now need to be earned by playing live matches against online opponents or requesting for matches during the playtimes of your FA
     Drop list amounts when making transfer bids scaled down and more incremental at the higher end
     No Trophies Won text on Trophies widgets updated to indicate whether it is for Youth or Senior trophies that have not been won
     When a player becomes a Free Agent their Most Recent Transfer Fee becomes reset to £0
     Fixed issue with Player/Staff names not appearing correctly in the client when certain 'special' characters were used (fix only applies to any new players/staff entering the game, at present the old effected ones are still effected)
     Server side performance optimisations

Match Experience Changes:
     Minor match rating /10 balancing changes (very slight buffs to defenders and GK's)
     GK Injuries occur less frequently
     Physio's have slightly more influence over preventing injuries from occurring
     Injury Resistance attribute of players has slightly more influence over preventing injuries from occurring to them (note: Injury Proneness attribute is a text description composite of both Injury Resistance and Injury Recovery
     Opponents aggression slider no longer has any bearing on the likelihood that your players could get injured
     Your own aggression slider now has more bearing on the likelihood that your own players could get injured
     Condition loss has slightly less overall negative impact on the performance level of players on the pitch (i.e. a slight nerf to backing off slider setting and high endurance players, and a slight buff to closing down slider setting and low endurance players)


Update v0.3.3k [2018-03-02]
     Manager Briefing widget now shows any Shareholder Dividend payment amount falling due at the end of the season
     Fixed TV Rights payments not being shown correctly in the Manager Briefing widget
     Note: TV Rights are making standard payments whilst we fix the issue of them not being processed correctly (once we've confirmed it's been fixed, we will correct any previously recorded incorrect data)
     Fixed cup competition logos and colour schemes not displaying
     Server side performance optimisations


Update v0.3.3l [2018-03-08]
     Shareholder Dividend Payments can now be seen in the projected transactions list on the finances page
     Shareholder Dividend Payments now appear on the 28 Day Projection table widget
     Shareholder Dividend Payments Threshold line now appears on the Finances Chart
     Prize Money is now paid out at the beginning of the following season rather than the end of the current season (so it won't be included as part of the Shareholder Dividend Payment calculation at the end of the current season)
     From midnight after release, TV Rights are now only projecting according to the percentages listed here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/468070/discussions/1/3377008022032648035/
     Auto-GUI rescaling on first login for new users, to ensure everything will fit properly if they don't have a resolution that is 1920 x 1080 or higher
     Various fixes to historical player stats records for clubs and competitions not showing correctly
     Trophies widgets will now scroll if user has too many different trophies to fit in the available space
     Manager Briefing messages related to U18 and U21 squads now reworded to make clearer

     Server side performance optimisations

notes.title: Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
August Update


New Features and Changes:
     There is now a 64 bit version of the game client for Windows on Steam.  Should improve performance on 64 bit operating systems and fix some OS level bugs that some users were facing associated with this
     Cup Matches and Friendly Matches can no longer result in a draw and will now go to extra time and penalty shootouts
     Injured and Suspended players can now play in Super Friendly League matches
     Added new Notification Settings widget to the Settings layout
     Added ‘Friendly Invitation’ event to sound settings
     Complete overhaul of Customise UI load/save/share interface and codebase.  Note: it’s still a WIP and there’s still issues with sharing layouts with other users
     Complete revamp of the default layout
     Now able to customise Squad List, Lineup List and Match Lineup List for Senior and Youth squads
     Clear and Autoselect buttons are now right aligned on Squad layout views
     Improved visual appearance, usability and responsiveness of the Uniform creator widget on the Customise layout
     Improved scaling/rescaling on Trophy Cabinet widget
     Trophy Room widget now displays text that no trophies have been won if no trophies have been won
     Improved rendering quality of logos
     Club Logo widget added to Club Profile Layout
     Online User-List widget added to Calendar Layout
     Sorting by the League column on FA Layouts will now sort by 1,2,3,4,5,etc rather than 1,10,2,3,4,5,etc
     Added right club drop list functionality when right clicking on Club names on results widget on Competition pages (previously only worked on the fixtures widget)
     Improved scaling of reputation stars column
     Improved increment value ranges on drop list for when bidding for Staff
     Improved account registration error pop-up message content/information
     Added many more flags for nationalities into the game client

Chat and Mail Message Changes and Fixes:
     Added Chat Agreement that user must accept in order to use the chat functionality in the game
     Added command to chat channels ‘/clear’ which will clear all text in the chat channel for the user (and will also fix any bugs caused for that user by broken hyperlinks)
     Added profanity filter to the game client
     Character Map Accents now supported (both 3 digit and 4 digit) i.e. (Alt + ???%)
     Now when a user has a ban from public chat they also cannot submit feedback
     Mail Messaging System is improved and optimised for better performance
     Hyperlink functionality added to mail messaging system
     Fixed bug where player names and links to player profiles not appearing in mail message notifications

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Drastic improvements to stability of matches, many reasons why matches can crash have been fixed
     Drastic improvements to match synchronisation and match UI performance (particularly with Pitch and Team Sheet overlays), making changes should be far more responsive now and many bugs associated with this have now been fixed
     Added individual player stats viewable on hover during matches (for Total Shots, Shots on Target, Chances Created, Key Defensive Plays, Assists, Fouls)
     Major commentary engine update
     More match sounds added
     Vuvuzela match ambiance option added
     Able to assign Penalty taker in tactics (draggable ‘P’ icon)
     Added extra time for cup matches (and friendly matches)
     Added penalty shootouts
     New match overlay for Penalty Shootouts
     Ability to order penalty shootout takers before penalty shootout commences
     New match event type of ‘Warnings’ (ticked-off by referee) with associated icon (white card with X mark inside)
     New rules for user personal pause clock timers.  120 seconds at start of match, 60 seconds added at half time, 60 seconds added at full time if the match will go to extra time
     New rules for match preparation and global pauses.  120 seconds to prepare before match starts, 30 seconds at half time, 30 seconds at full time if the match will go to extra time, 15 seconds at half time of extra time, 30 seconds before penalty shootout, 30 seconds for emergency time-outs
     Unless a user has actually connected to the match at some point, none of the global pauses will wait for that user (with the exception of the 120 seconds to prepare for the match which will apply if the user is online but hasn’t connected to the match yet)
     New ‘Apply’ / ‘Undo’ mechanism for tactical changes even whilst the match is not paused
     Applying changes whilst the match is paused by a user also automatically unpauses the match for that user.
     Applying changes now prevents user from making more changes until after those changes have been applied.
     Variable shaded size area under player shirts on tactics, so that players with longer names don’t protrude the edges of the shaded holding area/box
     User can now view their own Instructions overlay as it was at the end of the match, when viewing archived match reports from earlier in the season
     All instances of Club Names within match view are now clickable/linkable
     Player shirts are now loaded onto pitch before the match starts rather than as the match starts
     Various balancing improvements to the match engine, the overall ability for players and teams to defend has been improved slightly
     Now able to resize Match Instructions match overlay
     Now able to resize Match Statistics match overlay
     User is now able to put a player ‘in goal’ after their goal-keeper has been sent off, rather than having to use the Auto-Resolve button to achieve this (and then swap afterwards)
     Corrected font size inconsistencies on match performance overlay
     Fixed bug where your opponent making and applying tactical changes would cause your tactical changes that have not been applied to be undone
     Fixed bug where match colours were not updating correctly when a user was switching between matches
     Fixed bug where users spectating matches would not see substitutes come on to the pitch overlay
     Fixed bug where a user was able drag and drop to/from opponents players during a match (that would then cause changes to be made to your own players)
     Fixed bug where an emergency event could happen in the final minute of the match, then the match would complete, but the user would still be required to click Autoresolve in order to exit the match 
     Fixed bug where Match Spectators stopped seeing score changes after one of the clubs playing scored a goal and stopped seeing sub changes after one of the clubs made first sub
     Fixed bug where commentary would not show up to say that a player missed a penalty (only missed penalty icon would show)
     Fixed rare bug when receiving a red card, where shifting players around the pitch would coz a player to disappear from pitch view
     Fixed rare bug that could cause the ‘no 3rd sub bug’ to occur
     Fixed rare bug that a player on the pitch would replicate and show as if playing for opposition
     Fixed bug when showing ‘positions’ on the pitch overlay during a match you would still see the condition and match ratings for the players who are on the substitutes bench that had been substituted off during the match
     Positions/Numbers switch option was not working correctly when viewing match reports for previously played matches
     Fixed rare bug where the ‘Clear’ button could be partially covered by the pitch diagram

Other Bug Fixes:
     Fixed bug where often after making/changing/withdrawing a transfer bid for a player the player profile would not update and you wouldn’t know whether the bid worked or not unless you left the player profile and went back to it
     Fixed bug when making a bid for a Staff Member, on the profile it would immediately then show that there was 00:00 time remaining in the negotiation rather than 23:59
     Fixed bug where sometimes users couldn’t join live matches via the Live Matches widget on the Home Layout
     Fixed some of the reasons why OS might display an error when exiting the 90MF application
     Empty widget scalability fix
     Fixed bug associated with user trying to change their club name telling them it needs to be longer in character length when it doesn’t need to be
     Fixed bug where auctions incorrectly appear to be finishing earlier for some users
     Fixed rare bug where Latest Results widget would show (very) futuristic dates for matches (eg. in the year 2042)



Update v0.3.2a [2017-08-08]

New Features and Changes:
     Super Friendly League Matchmaking now takes into consideration reputation of clubs
     Super Friendly League Matchmaking now allows the same clubs to play each other twice every 48 hours rather than every week
     Limited User Status is now revoked immediately upon a user playing their 5th match online, rather than having to wait until the next hour mark to pass after playing their 5th match online (also fixed related bug where those 5 matches - had to be in the current season, now matches played in previous seasons also count)
     Information pop-up when changing FA’s now advises user that doing so might result in them being placed in a lower division than what they are in their current FA
     Search filter drop lists now work better when using the scaling GUI feature
     Added right club drop list functionality when right clicking on Club names on results widget on Competition pages (previously only worked on the fixtures widget)
     64 bit Windows Steam install of the game now only includes the files required for the 64 bit build and not also the files 32 bit build

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Pre-match phase will now wait for a user to click Kick-Off so long as that user is connected to the match (previously it would only wait for users who were online when the pre-match phase started)
     “Key Defensive Plays” name changed to “Chances Prevented”
     Fixed bug where guests/spectating users of matches could see the Penalty Taker icon of the away side
     Fixed bug where shots on target would not be displayed as part of the on-hover individual player statistics

Other Bug Fixes:
     Fixed bug where squad lists for some users would only load 2 or 3 players and then hang, usually for just a fraction of a second (but could be indefinite)
     Fixed bug where when making a bid for a player currently in a negotiation a pop-up window saying "Previous Request Still Being Processed" would be displayed
     Fixed bug where penalty shootout results displayed on the match-log on player profiles could incorrectly display which team won the penalty shootout
     Fixed bug where league tables for some Qualifying Leagues would not load
     Fixed extremely rare bug where league table data for youth leagues would not include a match result in them



Update v0.3.2b [2017-08-16]

New Features and Changes:
     Back/Forward arrow navigation now remembers which tab was selected on a layout rather than changing to the default tab
     Up/Down arrow navigation on player profiles now stays on the tab selected rather than changing to the default tab
     Improved resolution of the Friendly Match competition logo

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Refactored all of the codebase associated with substitutions to hopefully be done with the ‘no 3rd sub’ bug once and for all now!
     Competition plate (bottom right of match layout) now links to the competition page when clicked on
     Clicking on the competition information for each club at the top of the match layout will now link to the corresponding competition pages
     Youth matches now show in the title bar information about the position of which youth league each of the match participants are in
     Added desktop notification for any ‘breaks’ during match (including halftime, extra time, penalties)

Other Bug Fixes:
     The checkbox to apply conditions on player search was not working and conditions were always being applied whether the checkboxes were checked or not
     Sometimes horizontal scrollbars were appearing on widgets when they weren’t needed
     Fixed bug where bidding on players could cause client to lag after making a bid
     Fixed bug where on the pre-match tactics layout the penalty taker icon might not be visible
     Fixed bug where clicking on ‘GO TO MATCH’ button could take the user to an ‘empty’ screen
     Fixed bug where players are ‘selected’ to a youth squad who are no longer eligible to play for that youth squad because they are too old.  Note: these players were just selected on the shirts, they did not appear on the squad list, and these players would be automatically unselected just before the match starts



Update v0.3.2c [2017-09-07]

Changes and Fixes:
     Fixed not being able to bid on some free agents during a transfer negotiation (Stop the sign button incorrectly appearing instead of the bid button)
     Optimised Twitter boards and fixed Twitter boards not working when they had too many tweets
     Allow users to change there name on the 28th day after the last change rather than having to wait for more than 28 days
     Increased amount of staff being added into the game



Update v0.3.2d [2017-09-30]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Major core match engine update, having many knock on effects.  Including less cards (both red and yellow) being issued to bring the card numbers down to more realistic levels.  Matches are often 'tighter' and less goals generally being scored in matches to bring goal numbers down to more realistic levels.  Slightly more injury time being added to bring it up to more realistic levels.  ‘Unrealistic’ formations generally speaking are now even less effective.
     Major match commentary update
     Minor improvement to the visual representation of player pitch plates
     Fixed bug where during matches the player match stats pop up could be displayed in the wrong club colours

Chat and Mail Message Changes and Fixes:
     Profanity filter tuning (less ‘aggressive’ overall at filtering out words)
     Chat channel member list now has black background behind the member usernames
     Changed shade of grey being used to show usernames on chat (it is now slightly darker and more distinguishable from the white chat text)
     Usernames on match chat and private chat now changed to the same grey used on public chat (instead of being red)
     Usernames now hyperlink in many more places including on chat
     Fixed bug that was causing chat in matches to break when using some special characters

Other Changes and Fixes:
     All football playing countries in the world have now been added into the game along with flags for these countries
     Continents and countries now appear in alphabetical order in the player search
     Countries no longer displayed in UPPER case in some places and countries now consistently have the same names in all places throughout the game client
     Increased maximum possible reputation range difference for SFL matchmaking
     Decreased interest rate earned on bank balances (from 1% compound interest per season calculated daily to 0.5%)
     Improvements made to the Youth FA Competition registration popup to better inform the user exactly what they are in for the current season and the next season
     Improvements made to the Senior FA Competition registration popup to better inform the user exactly what they are in for the current season, the next season and the key things to be aware of when moving to a different FA
     Send Feedback prompt box now includes more information for the user about how to use it
     Preferences menu updates, now includes buttons for Code of Conduct and Video Tutorials
     Social media menu updates, now has glow effect on hover and has links added for Twitch and YouTube channels for 90MF
     Login splash screen social media links updated to be consistent with the social media menu links
     New Qualifying League competition logo
     Wikipedia button now has glow effect on hover
     Various security enhancements
     Fixed title bar colours not displaying correctly for youth FA's, Youth Leagues, Youth Cups, 90MF Cup, Sans Pareil Cup, Cup Holders' Cup and Qualifying Leagues
     Fixed rare bug where current season youth stats might not be cleared for some players at the start of a new season
     Can now remove your own staff member from your own shortlist



Update v0.3.2e [2017-10-02]

Changes and Fixes:
     Various country name and flag updates, fixed a few countries that were missing flags
     Changed auto-refresh rate for live auctions widget on home layout to update every 2 minutes rather than every minute
     Limit to number of live auctions being displayed, showing only the 500 auctions that are ending soonest



Update v0.3.2f [2017-10-10]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Core Match Engine Tuning
     Major server side communications update to increase stability of match server to main server communications

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have already signed another player from the club that owns the player in the past 30 days
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have a pending transfer for another player from the club that owns the player
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have another active transfer negotiation bid or transfer bid for a player from the club that owns the player
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have already made a transfer bid for a player if you have made another transfer bid in the past 24 hours (of any status that is not CANCELLED) for ANY OTHER player owned by the club that owns the player
     Profanity Filter tuning (less strict overall)
     Changed Wikipedia button on Reborn Legends Minigame to have same visual appearances as it does everywhere else in client
     Added button to link to Instructions for Reborn Legends Minigame (bottom right, and moved suggest player button to bottom left), Instructions themselves are WIP
     Security patch



Update v0.3.2g [2017-10-15]

Changes:
     Two New FA's added



Update v0.3.2h [2017-10-17]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Match commentary now appears circa 5% slower/longer

Reborn Legends Minigame Changes:
     Instructions link added
     Many new questions added
     Hundreds more players added
     Shows how many points are required for Legends Cup qualification next season

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Moved entire backend game server application onto entirely new server architecture facilitating the possibility for many scalability and performance enhancements to be made in the future (Note: Background urls have changed this may mean you need to re-add us to your firewall/anti-virus)
     Gameworld wide Twitter Board added to Home Layout
     Previous Legends Cup Winners widget added to World > Overview layout (although obviously returns empty at present)
     New logos and colour schemes for Sans Pareil Cup and Cup Holders' Cup
     Trophy image scaling fix for Trophy Cabinet widget
     Default layout updated
     Security patch



Update v0.3.2i [2017-10-19]

Reborn Legends Minigame Changes:
     Legends Cup qualification threshold lowered
     User will be told when they are in Initial Calibration phase

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Many widgets now auto-update less frequently to improve client performance
     Calendar widgets now auto-update data (before they only updated data on initial load)



Update v0.3.2j [2017-10-31]

Gameplay Changes:
     Contract renewal wages now completely reworked.  Older players have much lower wage demands now.  Youth players also have lower wage demands when first signed
     Determination now slightly more important for youth player development
     Natural Fitness attribute is now of greater importance for how long a player will maintain higher levels of attributes as they age
     Player creation balancing (should be a slightly better youth players created on average, and slightly more better attacking players created versus defensive players)
     League Competitions will start a little earlier each season
     Qualifying League fixtures are now scheduled so that the first fixtures will be played earlier
     Clubs are now able to have up to 60 players before they are unable to instantly sign free-agents (with varoius additional exceptions allowed: able to sign U18 player if <20 U18 players, sign U21 player if <20 U21 players, sign a GK if <6 GK's)
     Youth Coaching Staff will now have higher levels of Organisation attribute on average
     Players can now be released from contract up to 24 hours remaining in the season rather than 48 hours remaining
     Players can now have their contracts renegotiated up to 24 hours remaining in the season rather than 48 hours remaining
     Negotiation bids by the initially accepted bidder can be changed back to the initially accepted bid amount rather than needing to be greater than it

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Reborn Legends Minigame layout now tells all users (including Patreon Patrons) if they have qualified for next seasons Legends Cup
     Fixed the last remaining reason currently known why matches might not record after completion
     New logo and colour scheme for Qualifying Leagues
     League table results optimisations
     Home Layout performance optimisations (less frequent auto-refresh rates of widgets)
     Numerous server side optimisations
     Added account registration error message to advise users to try restarting their client first before emailing us as this will automatically resolve the main couple of reasons why it appears to them

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Minor balancing changes to the player rating /10 system


Update v0.3.2k [2017-11-05]

Changes:
     Legends Cup added
     Pre-match Welcome screen tips and messages added
     Negotiation layout in the Transfers menu now displays a much larger list of live auctions than what can be seen on the Home layout
     Login authentication now uses owner of the Steam 90MF application rather than the Steam ID of the account that is running the game (making 90MF consistent with how most other MMO's work on the Steam platform)
     Market Value 'decay' over time system completely reworked to work inline with the new wage demand system (overall the rate of MV decay will be much slower)
     Minor improvement to 'auto-select' AI

Bug Fixes:
     Qualifying Leagues now project points correctly when the clubs in that league will play less than 38 matches each


Update v0.3.2l [2017-11-30]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Match commentary update
     Minor balancing changes to the player rating /10 system (including non-penalty shootout Penalty Kicks during now impacting them)
     Very Minor Match Engine Balancing Change (only slight reduction in chance of Penalty Kick being awarded)

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Youth players generation balancing (should be a slightly better players created on average)
     Historical Player Data fix (club records should now show many players that were previously missing).  Note: there is still 1 more major issue for us to resolve in this space so some players will still be missing at present
     Wage demands now being shown correctly for months that don't have 30 days (previously it was amortising monthly wages as daily payments assuming that all months had 30 days when displaying this value)
     Wage being shown to users when making a bid for a player is now corrected to use new wage scaling and no longer rounds wages at higher levels
     Wage being shown to users when attempting to renegotiate contract for a player is now corrected to use new wage scaling and no longer rounds wages at higher levels
     Fixed Facebook Share functionality
     Minor profanity filter updates
     Technical infrastructure improvements and various server side performance enhancements


Update v0.3.2m [2017-12-11]
     Server side performance optimisations
