     User is now able to put a player ‘in goal’ after their goal-keeper has been sent off, rather than having to use the Auto-Resolve button to achieve this (and then swap afterwards)
     Corrected font size inconsistencies on match performance overlay
     Fixed bug where your opponent making and applying tactical changes would cause your tactical changes that have not been applied to be undone
     Fixed bug where match colours were not updating correctly when a user was switching between matches
     Fixed bug where users spectating matches would not see substitutes come on to the pitch overlay
     Fixed bug where a user was able drag and drop to/from opponents players during a match (that would then cause changes to be made to your own players)
     Fixed bug where an emergency event could happen in the final minute of the match, then the match would complete, but the user would still be required to click Autoresolve in order to exit the match 
     Fixed bug where Match Spectators stopped seeing score changes after one of the clubs playing scored a goal and stopped seeing sub changes after one of the clubs made first sub
     Fixed bug where commentary would not show up to say that a player missed a penalty (only missed penalty icon would show)
     Fixed rare bug when receiving a red card, where shifting players around the pitch would coz a player to disappear from pitch view
     Fixed rare bug that could cause the ‘no 3rd sub bug’ to occur
     Fixed rare bug that a player on the pitch would replicate and show as if playing for opposition
     Fixed bug when showing ‘positions’ on the pitch overlay during a match you would still see the condition and match ratings for the players who are on the substitutes bench that had been substituted off during the match
     Positions/Numbers switch option was not working correctly when viewing match reports for previously played matches
     Fixed rare bug where the ‘Clear’ button could be partially covered by the pitch diagram

Other Bug Fixes:
     Fixed bug where often after making/changing/withdrawing a transfer bid for a player the player profile would not update and you wouldn’t know whether the bid worked or not unless you left the player profile and went back to it
     Fixed bug when making a bid for a Staff Member, on the profile it would immediately then show that there was 00:00 time remaining in the negotiation rather than 23:59
     Fixed bug where sometimes users couldn’t join live matches via the Live Matches widget on the Home Layout
     Fixed some of the reasons why OS might display an error when exiting the 90MF application
     Empty widget scalability fix
     Fixed bug associated with user trying to change their club name telling them it needs to be longer in character length when it doesn’t need to be
     Fixed bug where auctions incorrectly appear to be finishing earlier for some users
     Fixed rare bug where Latest Results widget would show (very) futuristic dates for matches (eg. in the year 2042)



Update v0.3.2a [2017-08-08]

New Features and Changes:
     Super Friendly League Matchmaking now takes into consideration reputation of clubs
     Super Friendly League Matchmaking now allows the same clubs to play each other twice every 48 hours rather than every week
     Limited User Status is now revoked immediately upon a user playing their 5th match online, rather than having to wait until the next hour mark to pass after playing their 5th match online (also fixed related bug where those 5 matches - had to be in the current season, now matches played in previous seasons also count)
     Information pop-up when changing FA’s now advises user that doing so might result in them being placed in a lower division than what they are in their current FA
     Search filter drop lists now work better when using the scaling GUI feature
     Added right club drop list functionality when right clicking on Club names on results widget on Competition pages (previously only worked on the fixtures widget)
     64 bit Windows Steam install of the game now only includes the files required for the 64 bit build and not also the files 32 bit build

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Pre-match phase will now wait for a user to click Kick-Off so long as that user is connected to the match (previously it would only wait for users who were online when the pre-match phase started)
     “Key Defensive Plays” name changed to “Chances Prevented”
     Fixed bug where guests/spectating users of matches could see the Penalty Taker icon of the away side
     Fixed bug where shots on target would not be displayed as part of the on-hover individual player statistics

Other Bug Fixes:
     Fixed bug where squad lists for some users would only load 2 or 3 players and then hang, usually for just a fraction of a second (but could be indefinite)
     Fixed bug where when making a bid for a player currently in a negotiation a pop-up window saying "Previous Request Still Being Processed" would be displayed
     Fixed bug where penalty shootout results displayed on the match-log on player profiles could incorrectly display which team won the penalty shootout
     Fixed bug where league tables for some Qualifying Leagues would not load
     Fixed extremely rare bug where league table data for youth leagues would not include a match result in them



Update v0.3.2b [2017-08-16]

New Features and Changes:
     Back/Forward arrow navigation now remembers which tab was selected on a layout rather than changing to the default tab
     Up/Down arrow navigation on player profiles now stays on the tab selected rather than changing to the default tab
     Improved resolution of the Friendly Match competition logo

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Refactored all of the codebase associated with substitutions to hopefully be done with the ‘no 3rd sub’ bug once and for all now!
     Competition plate (bottom right of match layout) now links to the competition page when clicked on
     Clicking on the competition information for each club at the top of the match layout will now link to the corresponding competition pages
     Youth matches now show in the title bar information about the position of which youth league each of the match participants are in
     Added desktop notification for any ‘breaks’ during match (including halftime, extra time, penalties)

Other Bug Fixes:
     The checkbox to apply conditions on player search was not working and conditions were always being applied whether the checkboxes were checked or not
     Sometimes horizontal scrollbars were appearing on widgets when they weren’t needed
     Fixed bug where bidding on players could cause client to lag after making a bid
     Fixed bug where on the pre-match tactics layout the penalty taker icon might not be visible
     Fixed bug where clicking on ‘GO TO MATCH’ button could take the user to an ‘empty’ screen
     Fixed bug where players are ‘selected’ to a youth squad who are no longer eligible to play for that youth squad because they are too old.  Note: these players were just selected on the shirts, they did not appear on the squad list, and these players would be automatically unselected just before the match starts



Update v0.3.2c [2017-09-07]

Changes and Fixes:
     Fixed not being able to bid on some free agents during a transfer negotiation (Stop the sign button incorrectly appearing instead of the bid button)
     Optimised Twitter boards and fixed Twitter boards not working when they had too many tweets
     Allow users to change there name on the 28th day after the last change rather than having to wait for more than 28 days
     Increased amount of staff being added into the game



Update v0.3.2d [2017-09-30]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Major core match engine update, having many knock on effects.  Including less cards (both red and yellow) being issued to bring the card numbers down to more realistic levels.  Matches are often 'tighter' and less goals generally being scored in matches to bring goal numbers down to more realistic levels.  Slightly more injury time being added to bring it up to more realistic levels.  ‘Unrealistic’ formations generally speaking are now even less effective.
     Major match commentary update
     Minor improvement to the visual representation of player pitch plates
     Fixed bug where during matches the player match stats pop up could be displayed in the wrong club colours

Chat and Mail Message Changes and Fixes:
     Profanity filter tuning (less ‘aggressive’ overall at filtering out words)
     Chat channel member list now has black background behind the member usernames
     Changed shade of grey being used to show usernames on chat (it is now slightly darker and more distinguishable from the white chat text)
     Usernames on match chat and private chat now changed to the same grey used on public chat (instead of being red)
     Usernames now hyperlink in many more places including on chat
     Fixed bug that was causing chat in matches to break when using some special characters

Other Changes and Fixes:
     All football playing countries in the world have now been added into the game along with flags for these countries
     Continents and countries now appear in alphabetical order in the player search
     Countries no longer displayed in UPPER case in some places and countries now consistently have the same names in all places throughout the game client
     Increased maximum possible reputation range difference for SFL matchmaking
     Decreased interest rate earned on bank balances (from 1% compound interest per season calculated daily to 0.5%)
     Improvements made to the Youth FA Competition registration popup to better inform the user exactly what they are in for the current season and the next season
     Improvements made to the Senior FA Competition registration popup to better inform the user exactly what they are in for the current season, the next season and the key things to be aware of when moving to a different FA
     Send Feedback prompt box now includes more information for the user about how to use it
     Preferences menu updates, now includes buttons for Code of Conduct and Video Tutorials
     Social media menu updates, now has glow effect on hover and has links added for Twitch and YouTube channels for 90MF
     Login splash screen social media links updated to be consistent with the social media menu links
     New Qualifying League competition logo
     Wikipedia button now has glow effect on hover
     Various security enhancements
     Fixed title bar colours not displaying correctly for youth FA's, Youth Leagues, Youth Cups, 90MF Cup, Sans Pareil Cup, Cup Holders' Cup and Qualifying Leagues
     Fixed rare bug where current season youth stats might not be cleared for some players at the start of a new season
     Can now remove your own staff member from your own shortlist



Update v0.3.2e [2017-10-02]

Changes and Fixes:
     Various country name and flag updates, fixed a few countries that were missing flags
     Changed auto-refresh rate for live auctions widget on home layout to update every 2 minutes rather than every minute
     Limit to number of live auctions being displayed, showing only the 500 auctions that are ending soonest



Update v0.3.2f [2017-10-10]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Core Match Engine Tuning
     Major server side communications update to increase stability of match server to main server communications

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have already signed another player from the club that owns the player in the past 30 days
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have a pending transfer for another player from the club that owns the player
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have another active transfer negotiation bid or transfer bid for a player from the club that owns the player
     Added restriction to not allow users to bid for a player if they have already made a transfer bid for a player if you have made another transfer bid in the past 24 hours (of any status that is not CANCELLED) for ANY OTHER player owned by the club that owns the player
     Profanity Filter tuning (less strict overall)
     Changed Wikipedia button on Reborn Legends Minigame to have same visual appearances as it does everywhere else in client
     Added button to link to Instructions for Reborn Legends Minigame (bottom right, and moved suggest player button to bottom left), Instructions themselves are WIP
     Security patch



Update v0.3.2g [2017-10-15]

Changes:
     Two New FA's added



Update v0.3.2h [2017-10-17]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Match commentary now appears circa 5% slower/longer

Reborn Legends Minigame Changes:
     Instructions link added
     Many new questions added
     Hundreds more players added
     Shows how many points are required for Legends Cup qualification next season

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Moved entire backend game server application onto entirely new server architecture facilitating the possibility for many scalability and performance enhancements to be made in the future (Note: Background urls have changed this may mean you need to re-add us to your firewall/anti-virus)
     Gameworld wide Twitter Board added to Home Layout
     Previous Legends Cup Winners widget added to World > Overview layout (although obviously returns empty at present)
     New logos and colour schemes for Sans Pareil Cup and Cup Holders' Cup
     Trophy image scaling fix for Trophy Cabinet widget
     Default layout updated
     Security patch



Update v0.3.2i [2017-10-19]

Reborn Legends Minigame Changes:
     Legends Cup qualification threshold lowered
     User will be told when they are in Initial Calibration phase

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Many widgets now auto-update less frequently to improve client performance
     Calendar widgets now auto-update data (before they only updated data on initial load)



Update v0.3.2j [2017-10-31]

Gameplay Changes:
     Contract renewal wages now completely reworked.  Older players have much lower wage demands now.  Youth players also have lower wage demands when first signed
     Determination now slightly more important for youth player development
     Natural Fitness attribute is now of greater importance for how long a player will maintain higher levels of attributes as they age
     Player creation balancing (should be a slightly better youth players created on average, and slightly more better attacking players created versus defensive players)
     League Competitions will start a little earlier each season
     Qualifying League fixtures are now scheduled so that the first fixtures will be played earlier
     Clubs are now able to have up to 60 players before they are unable to instantly sign free-agents (with varoius additional exceptions allowed: able to sign U18 player if <20 U18 players, sign U21 player if <20 U21 players, sign a GK if <6 GK's)
     Youth Coaching Staff will now have higher levels of Organisation attribute on average
     Players can now be released from contract up to 24 hours remaining in the season rather than 48 hours remaining
     Players can now have their contracts renegotiated up to 24 hours remaining in the season rather than 48 hours remaining
     Negotiation bids by the initially accepted bidder can be changed back to the initially accepted bid amount rather than needing to be greater than it

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Reborn Legends Minigame layout now tells all users (including Patreon Patrons) if they have qualified for next seasons Legends Cup
     Fixed the last remaining reason currently known why matches might not record after completion
     New logo and colour scheme for Qualifying Leagues
     League table results optimisations
     Home Layout performance optimisations (less frequent auto-refresh rates of widgets)
     Numerous server side optimisations
     Added account registration error message to advise users to try restarting their client first before emailing us as this will automatically resolve the main couple of reasons why it appears to them

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Minor balancing changes to the player rating /10 system


Update v0.3.2k [2017-11-05]

Changes:
     Legends Cup added
     Pre-match Welcome screen tips and messages added
     Negotiation layout in the Transfers menu now displays a much larger list of live auctions than what can be seen on the Home layout
     Login authentication now uses owner of the Steam 90MF application rather than the Steam ID of the account that is running the game (making 90MF consistent with how most other MMO's work on the Steam platform)
     Market Value 'decay' over time system completely reworked to work inline with the new wage demand system (overall the rate of MV decay will be much slower)
     Minor improvement to 'auto-select' AI

Bug Fixes:
     Qualifying Leagues now project points correctly when the clubs in that league will play less than 38 matches each


Update v0.3.2l [2017-11-30]

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Match commentary update
     Minor balancing changes to the player rating /10 system (including non-penalty shootout Penalty Kicks during now impacting them)
     Very Minor Match Engine Balancing Change (only slight reduction in chance of Penalty Kick being awarded)

Other Changes and Fixes:
     Youth players generation balancing (should be a slightly better players created on average)
     Historical Player Data fix (club records should now show many players that were previously missing).  Note: there is still 1 more major issue for us to resolve in this space so some players will still be missing at present
     Wage demands now being shown correctly for months that don't have 30 days (previously it was amortising monthly wages as daily payments assuming that all months had 30 days when displaying this value)
     Wage being shown to users when making a bid for a player is now corrected to use new wage scaling and no longer rounds wages at higher levels
     Wage being shown to users when attempting to renegotiate contract for a player is now corrected to use new wage scaling and no longer rounds wages at higher levels
     Fixed Facebook Share functionality
     Minor profanity filter updates
     Technical infrastructure improvements and various server side performance enhancements


Update v0.3.2m [2017-12-11]
     Server side performance optimisations

notes.title: Update 0.3.1 (17 May)
notes.content:
May Update

Note: this release was done on the 17th May but it seems the News Announcement didn't work at the time so am re-posting it now.


New Features and Changes:
     New Table Editor that includes functionality to select which columns you want shown, the order they are shown, the names of the columns, the widths of the columns and the sorting rules to be applied (Patreon)
     Up/Down player navigation arrows in title bar to contextually navigate from player list that was linked from (works with squads, tables, search results, match day squads and more) as well as keyboard Up+Down arrow shortcuts (Patreon)
     Reborn Legends are now automatically released from contract if the owning user has not logged in for 28 consecutive days.  There is now also a warning message displaying this data when a user attempts to sign a Reborn Legend (Patreon)
     Release a player from contract even if owned for less than 28 days by paying out their remaining contract (Patreon)
     Added Trophy Room widget to the Profile layout (Patreon)
     Added ELO Club Rankings for Senior, U21, U18, Youth (combined U21 & U18) and Composite (combined Senior & Youth) (Patreon)
     Added hyperlinks to Cup Competitions from various layouts within the game (Patreon)
     Added Twitter Boards for all Competitions and FA's (Patreon)
     Player and Staff Wages now displayed more accurately and no longer has higher level rounding applied at higher levels (Patreon)
     User Administration widget added to the Settings layout, allowing users to change their Username, Club Name and reset their teams
     Various improvements to the Team Colour Picker including the ability to utilise Dark colurs (including Black) now being supported as a main team colour (with many changes throughout the client to support this), it showing what the selected colours would look like in the title bar before saving/applying them, and optimisations to make it update quicker
     Improve New Club/User registration process (including Club names must now be unique in game)
     Title Bar now shows username for Profile, Home, Settings, Mail and Chat Views
     Title Bar when viewing a Youth Squad, now shows the League and place information for the relevant Youth Squad rather than that users Senior Squad
     Show users Selected FA as being SELECTED rather than FULL when it is Full
     Rejecting transfer bid pop-up now has a 'Close' button added
     Removed Login Statistics Widget from users profile layout (complaints received citing invasion of privacy)
     Various improvements to Private Chat including being able to reorder chat tabs and showing chat tabs by default that have unread messages on them
     Various improvements to Public Chat including reorder channel tabs and mute settings for each channel
     Added DDOS warning pop-up if user is sending requests to server too rapidly (i.e. clicking the mouse button too rapidly)
     Changes to simplify the display of names for some countries (i.e. Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is now Saudi Arabia) and updated some flags
     Season Name (i.e. Mar 2017) rather than Season Number is now being shown in Historical Cup Performance, Historical League Performance and Club Reputation widgets
     Added Club Reputation Chart widget to Club Profile layout
     Added Transfer Block information pop-up
     Added Staff Retirement Announcement mail message notifications
     Added Staff Retirement Announcement information to the Staff Contract Details widget
     Auto-Accept amounts can now be set to higher than £25m
     Twitter boards now show Tweets in reverse chronological order
     The making of Transfer Bids is now anonymous
     Added Transfer Fee Column to Career History Widget (Patreon) note: values not being populated yet
     When a user has a client build out of date the server forces them to log off and update the client
     Possibility to cancel Twitter Tag name change
     Maximum possible tabs per layout increased from 5 to 6
     Re-coded GUI scaling from scratch on the Settings layout.  Many improvements including better scaling, showing of decimal places, and various bug fixes
     Display reason/s to user for account banning at client launch screen
     Removed OL% from League Tables (was leading to too much confusion)
     DDOS protection enhancements
     Improved scalability of Attribute Progression chart widget to improve play experience on smaller display resolutions
     Improved scalability of Finances chart widget to improve play experience on smaller display resolutions
     Improved scalability of Reputation chart widget to improve play experience on smaller display resolutions
     Various client optimisations

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Fixed another cause of the 'no 3rd sub' bug (where user was unable to make a 3rd substitution during a match)
     Fixed 'missing player' bug (where user had a player disappear from the match overlay during a match)
     Re-coded many match visual UI elements from scratch to increase performance
     Fixed tabs in match UI being shown in users main colours rather than their match colours when away or 3rd kit is being used for the user
     Fixed bug that could cause user to disconnect from match
     Fixed missing icons/players on pitch bug during matches
     Improved scalability of icons during matches to improve play experience on smaller display resolutions
     Fixed match tabs having wrong colours on start when user is not using home kit

Bug Fixes:
     These characters \|"/*?#@_$<> ^ are now no longer destroying hyperlinks in chat and mail messages
     Fixed empty chat tab bug
     Fixed private chat message going to wrong user bug
     Match Sounds Slider in settings was not muting other sounds like goals, saves and whlstles
     Exporting data to CSV Files now working on Mac
     Some buttons (like Auto Accept, Auto Reject, Release from Contract) were incorrectly being shown when a player had a transfer Arranged
     Clicking on the date of a match in the Latest Results widget was not hyperlinking to the report for that match
     Close button now working from the prompt to report a transfer bid for your own player
     Fixed user list from being of incorrect scaling on smaller screen resolutions

     Club Transfer History widgets for incoming and outgoing transfers added (Patreon)
     Show positional information for players on the Pitch overlay and in Team Instructions + button quality improved (Patreon)
     Add the max possible bid amount value in the drop list of pre-defined values when making a bid (Patreon)
     Button to remove all players from Shortlist (Patreon)
     Finances Chart Axis Title Rename
     Inform Users when their client build is out of date
     Remember sound settings after closing client
     Reduce default volume of whistle notification sound
     Enhanced sound settings
     Blacklist widget in the Options Layout
     Missing Flags added
     Inform users of progress of daily server maintenance at midnight UTC
     Information plates now displayed when looking at opponents squads
     Nationality now displayed when looking at opponents squads
     Ability to view opponents U21/U18 squads
     Change icon for Game Guide and move it to sit within preferences menu
     Allow users to register for Beta from within the Live client
     Option to Report Users
     Improved feedback to users when they cannot make transfer bids or renegotiate contracts of players during the last 48 hours of the season
     Added £25M option to drop list when making a transfer bid
     Transfer Value is now known as Market Value throughout
     Extra columns for Current Wage, Market Value, Most Recent Transfer Fee and Wikipedia added to Current Negotiations widget
     Improved widget where users join FA's on the World > Overview layout
     Users now select to join an FA when they first create their club
     Users now prompted to join an FA when they sign in to the client, if they are not already a member of an active FA

     Improvements Current Auctions column order and widths

notes.title: Staff Coming 1st March
notes.content:
The next major release will be on the 1st March.  This release will include the beginnings of the Staff feature being added into the game.


More information about the staff feature can be found here:
https://90minutefever.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=26558663

And a podcast discussing staff is here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5fk2IQ7Sqj8&list=PLO4WvNC3TJwzFPGOCE7dR67L3afxobsqZ&index=4&t=163s



The main thing users should be aware of how to plan for next season is the coming Soft Squad Limit.

What is the Soft Squad Limit?
The Soft Squad Limit is an amount of players that a club is able to train optimally.  Clubs are allowed to exceed the Soft Squad Limit and have as many players as they want on their books, however, if they exceed this limit then the quality of the training their players will receive will be increasingly compromised the greater the soft limit is exceeded by.


How many players are allowed under the Soft Squad Limit?
Clubs are allowed to have up to 16 players aged over 21, and 16 players aged up to and including 21, making up to 32 players in total under the soft limit.  The staff skill ‘Organisation’ allows for these limits to be increased.  By 1 youth player per attribute point in the Youth Coach, and by 1 senior player per 2 attribute points for the Senior coach.  Potentially bringing the total ‘soft’ limit up to 62 players in total for a squad.  

For example, a Senior Coach with an Organisation rating of 10, increases the number of Senior Players (i.e. 22 and over) a user can train without penalty from 16 to 21 - an increase of 5. A Senior Coach with an Organisation rating of 20, increases the number of Senior Players (i.e. 22 and over) a user can train without penalty from 16 to 26 - an increase of 10.

This works exactly the same for Youth Coaches except that the effect is doubled. For example, a Youth Coach with an Organisation rating of 10, increases the number of Youth Players (i.e. 21 and under) a user can train without penalty from 16 to 26 - an increase of 10. A Youth Coach with an Organisation rating of 20, increases the number of Youth Players (i.e. 21 and under) a user can train without penalty from 16 to 36 - an increase of 20.

For clarity, users can still have more players than their Soft Limit. All that happens is that the training of all their players is slightly less effective for every player they go over their limit





In addition to staff there will also be a series of other enhancements including transfer system changes as well as the introduction of self-moderation of userbase behaviour. 

The transfer system changes include:

Transfer Bid Withdrawal Penalty

Once you make a transfer bid for a player who is not currently in a transfer negotiation, withdrawing that bid will incur a penalty fee (10% of the bid amount).  Lowering that transfer bid will incur a penalty fee (10% of the lowered amount).

Lowering a transfer bid does not reset the 24 hour bid time (but you do have to pay the lowering bid penalty fee).

Increasing a transfer bid does reset the 24 hour bid time (no penalty fee is payable for doing this).


Transfer Bid Rejection Wage Discount

Rejecting a transfer bid, applies a discount to the wage increase demanded by the player as a result of the increased valuation of the player by up to 50%.  The quicker the user rejects the bid, the greater the discount.  Note: casual users can avoid being adversely impacted by this change by setting Auto-Reject amounts for their players.


Add Signing Fee

Add a 10% Signing Fee (to go to player/agent) when signing a player from another user (it does not affect youth players or free agents). This fee is waived if you were the user who had the initially accepted bid.  Note: this is in addition to the already given wage discount for being the initial bidder.  This makes it massively advantageous to be the initial bidder in transfer negotiations.



A podcast discussing these transfer system changes and self-moderation of the user-base is here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2rhIcr8cts&index=5&list=PLO4WvNC3TJwzFPGOCE7dR67L3afxobsqZ


There also a lot of other features included in this release too, including numerous bug fixes, commentary enhancements, and changes to the match experience.  Too many to mention in this post, but check out the changelog in Beta if you are interested in the full list!

We would like to say a particular thank you to the Patreon users for enabling these features (and many more) to be among them...
    Ability to change background images in the game client
    Ability to change foreground text colour in the game client
    Club Transfer Histories
    Search for users and clubs
    Match sounds
    Separate calendars for youth squads
    Online statuses for users
    Information about when the owning user of a player was last online
    Option to show/hide attribute progression arrows.

notes.title: Update v0.2.4a
notes.content:
December Hotfixes

New Features:
     Added pop-up to let user know they have not saved changes to their tactic when leaving their tactic
     Added pop-up to let user know if the formation they are looking at is not set to default when leaving their tactic
     Added ability to view opponents separate squads (for Senior, U21, U18) in the user right click drop list

Changes:
     Enhanced Team Instructions Sliders to be more responsive and to correctly update even when the user makes many changes quickly at the same time, and to fix a few bugs
     Improved scalability of Match Chat match overlay
     Improved scalability of Team Performance match overlay
     Improved scalability of Pitch match overlay
     Improved visual appearance of the Match Stats match overlay
     Reduced size of Team Instructions match overlay
     Improved visual appearance and column data available when viewing opposition squads, bringing them inline with when user is viewing their own squad.
     Improved spacing, sizing and ‘click area’ of the apply and cancel changes buttons when in Customising UI mode. Ensuring that users do not accidentally discard changes they intended to apply.
     The social media Share button is now hidden when in Customising UI mode
     Disabled the Download Warning pop-up preventing it from appearing
     Added a % symbol to the Weighting column in the Club Reputation widget on the Club layout
     Improved rounding of reputation figures on the Club Reputation, Historical Cup Performance and Historical League Performance widgets on the Club Layout
     Added £25M option to the drop list of bid amounts when making a transfer bid
     Added £250k option to the drop list of wage amounts when re-negotiating players contracts
     Increased range for Player Search to allow values up to £50M

Bug Fixes:
     Match Statistics now resetting before you start another match not immediately after (so you don't get a flash of the previous match stats when you first kick off a match)
     Fixed a bug that could cause issues in matches where the competition colours were not correctly set on the server
     Fixed another bug that could cause the prevention of a user being able to make a 3rd substitution (when a user would make changes in the tactics tab and before they could be applied server side, quickly had made additional changes on the Pitch overlay)
     Fixed a bug that would prevent some mail message notifications from being shown



Update v0.2.4b [2016-12-17]

Changes:
- Players who receive knocks during matches, will end up with some condition loss persisting after the match has finished
- Meeting the OL% in FA's is now used as qualification criteria to enter Community Trophy competitions, instead of for retaining FA Membership.  Users will retain their FA Membership if they are actively playing the game irrespective of their OL%

notes.title: Update v0.2.4
notes.content:
Youth Squads and Competitions Release

New Features:

    Added ability to Join U21 and U18 Youth FA’s (and to de-register for the following season)
    Added qualifying Leagues for U21 and U18 Youth FA’s
    Added tiered League Structure for U21 and U18 Youth FA’s (including 6 promotions/relegations)
    Added FA Cup for U21 and U18 Youth FA’s
    Added possibility for users to have additional U21 and U18 Squads
    Tracking extra player statistics for U21 and U18 Levels
    Added extra club menu items to access youth squads
    Added extra options to Request Match button to request U21 and U18 Official matches
    Added extra options when right clicking on User, to challenge them to U21 and U18 Friendly Matches (provided they have the required youth squad)
    Added rule where if a user doesn’t have enough players in a squad to field a team, the ‘AI’ will first look to add players from your other squads that are eligible before it signs available Free Agents
    New Layout ‘World > Youth Competitions’
    New Widget ‘Youth FA’s’ added to ‘Youth Competitions’ Layout
    New Widget ‘Choose Youth FA’ added to ‘Youth Competitions’ Layout
    New Layouts for Youth FA’s and along with many Widgets
    Added ability to right click on players and add/remove them from Senior, U21 and U18 squads
    Added U21 and U18 youth match statistics to the ‘Season Stats’ Widget on ‘Player Profile’ Layout
    Added attribute progression arrows to the Attributes Widget on the Player Profile Layout
    Added ‘Most Recent Transfer Fee’ information to the ‘Transfer Details’ Widget on ‘Player Profile’ Layout
    Added ‘Condition %’ information to the ‘Availability’ Widget on the ‘Player Profile’ Layout
    Added new game rule to not allow Free Agents to be signed immediately unless they have been a Free Agent for at least 7 days.  If a player has been a Free Agent for less than 7 days they must be signed via a Free Agent Negotiation
    Added new game rule to allow injured and suspended players to be selected for Senior Friendly and for Youth Matches (both competitive and friendly).  Players will also always start Friendly and Youth Matches with 100% condition (even if they have less due to recovering from injury)
    Added ‘Club Reputation’ widget to the Club > Profile Layout
    Added ‘Historical Cup Performance’ widget to the Club > Profile Layout
    Added new game rule to give new users a ‘Limited’ status.  Users with this status cannot make transfer bids for players owned by other users, cannot join a Senior FA and cannot join Youth FA’s.  A user can lose their ‘Limited’ status simply by playing 5 online matches (including Friendlies)
    Complete rewrite of the player search code (fixing many bugs in the process, generally making it a lot more stable, and a lot easier for us to enhance further in the future)
    Added extra player search condition ‘User Active Last 48h’
    Added extra player search condition ‘Reborn Legend’
    Added ability to export player data (by right clicking on player)
    Added ability to export squad data (by right clicking on user/club)
    Added ability to export player search results (by clicking the Export button) in the player search
    Added the name of the competition for a match whilst it is being played to the bottom right corner of the Match Layout
    Added some new logos for leagues
    Added error message pop-up to let user know if they cannot download data from server
    Important Note: Attribute Progression and Regression logic is unchanged in Live for now.  It will be changed later on after further testing in Beta.




Match Simulator Changes and Bug Fixes:

    Balancing update to match engine.  Goal Keeper’s should now be better overall.  Less goals should be scored overall.
    Complete rewrite of code for how tactical changes are applied during matches.  Instruction sliders and player position changes now instantly react and Tactical Changes during matches are now applied at the beginning of the next match minute rather than the end of the next match minute
    Enhanced player rating logic.  Outfield players should now have slightly lower overall match ratings, and Goal Keepers should have slightly higher overall match ratings
    Enhanced logic to choose Man of the Match
    Minor enhancements to the match commentary engine
    Fixed a bug with the match commentary engine where it would select the exact same commentary sequence for a similar event if those events happened too close to each other
    Fixed a bug that would sometimes prevent a user from being able to make a 3rd substitution during matches
    Fixed various bugs when using the ‘Auto-resolve’ button in the case of Injuries and Red Cards
    Fixed a rare bug where the half-time pause could be skipped in some matches




Other Changes:

    Changed the Game Guide icon to a ‘book’ and moved it to sit within the Preferences menu
    Improved layout of the Tactics screens when not in match.  For some users with smaller resolutions it didn’t fit entirely on the screen
    Transaction Types in the Finances Layout now appear in more human readable format (without underscores and with letter casing)
    The showing of the online status of Users during matches is now more ‘stable’
    Removed ‘Stadium’ from the Club Menu




Other Bug Fixes:

    Negotiations that are ‘ending soon’ now appear in the correct sort order in the ‘Current Negotiations’ Widget on the ‘Home’ Layout
    Fixed issue where sometimes user list would be empty and remain empty until user restarted their client
    Fixed some causes of ‘ghost’ icons appearing from the previous match
    Fixed bug where sometimes user would hear a mail message notification sound although there was no message in their inbox
    Fixed bug which would sometimes result in users not being able to see new mail messages they have received
    Sometimes wrong Logo’s were being shown for competitions
    Fixed some issues with tables resizing incorrectly when user was customising their layouts
    Fixed a very rare bug that could result in a Contract Renegotiation not being won by the correct user
    Fixed a bug where the Instructions Overlay during matches was active but was shown as being inactive in the footer bar
    Fixed various bugs with career statistics leaders not adding up to correct amounts within their profiles
    Players now sorting by Appearances column correctly in Squad Layout
    Players now sorting by Position column correctly in Squad Layout
    Fixed bug where ‘GO TO MATCH’ button would still appear even though user had completed their match
    Fixed a variety of bugs associated with users saving their custom UI layouts
    Double copy/paste issue in chat fixed (Mac only bug)
    Fixed bug where users were unable to scroll up and down in squad and lineup layouts (Mac only bug)
    Fixed bug where operating system would think the game client was still running even though the user had closed it, and they needed to force quit Steam (Mac only bug)

notes.title: Beta Access
notes.content:
Paying users are also able to play 90 Minute Fever in the Beta world via Steam if they would like.  This is an entirely separate Game World where you will have an entirely Separate team.  This world has been running since December last year.  Game updates will always be deployed into Beta first.  So if you'd like to have a glimpse into the future for what is to come into live, or if you would like to play more with a 2nd team in a 2nd Game World then you should probably try out also playing in Beta.


How to Gain Beta Access?

Please fill out this form to request access to Beta via Steam:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1pViDzwDeAhrpWYYw5PKUbuGrPD-hnnuCEnEw382tqAnkzA/viewform

We will periodically process these requests.  It should not take more than 24 hours to gain access.  When we process your request it will be obvious to you because in your steam library you'll see another game appear that will be named '90 Minute Fever - beta'.  We will automatically add the game to your Steam library.  It will be added to the same Steam account as you are using to access 90 Minute Fever at the moment.

Please note: only paying users with an active monthly subscription on Steam will be granted this access.



Users who don't current have access to Beta

When you launch the game, select the option that you are a new user.  You will be taken through the process to create a new team.



Users who currently have access to Beta off of Steam

When you launch the game, select the option that you are an existing user if you want to continue to use your existing Beta team.  

If you would like to start again, please still select you are an existing user and then let us know.  We will arrange for your user account to be reset and for you to be able to start again.

Note: unlike in Live, it is not acceptable in Beta for a single individual person to have more than 1 user account.  If any user is found out to be doing this, both accounts will be permanently banned/disabled.

For the team being, you will be able to continue to access off of Steam if you choose.

notes.title: End of August Release Update
notes.content:
The end of August release has not happened yet.  We've been working very long hours this entire month hoping we could make it happen, but unfortunately we've fallen a little short.


Billing Issues
The main (well, pretty much only) reason there is a delay is due to the billing issues we have been having with Steam.  These have resulted in a huge amount of work for us.  Both in regards to manually resolving 100's of individual user cases as well as trying to come up with permanent solutions going forwards.  A lot of progress has been made on this front and we expect that we'll have this situation under control before the end of this month.  Unfortunately this issue could not have been foreseen by us - and the scale of the amount of work involved here for us has been truly epic.

We have been doing our absolute best to try get in the End of August update on time but we've not quite been able to pull it off.  Whilst it is very important for us that we deliver updates on time, it is more important to us that we deliver updates with the correct amount of quality and testing.  

There are some known issues with the current release and we're still working on resolving these, but most of the current release is of a good enough standard to be deployed into Beta and this will happen tomorrow late afternoon.  


Beta Access 
Anyone who is a paying user is able to request access to Beta.  To request this access please fill out this form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1pViDzwDeAhrpWYYw5PKUbuGrPD-hnnuCEnEw382tqAnkzA/viewform

If you do so you'll be granted Beta access within 24 hours of doing so.  This will add another 90MF client application for Beta into your Steam library.  Existing beta users are able to fill out this request as well.  It will be possible to have both 90MF Clients (for Live and Beta) open at the same time.

The full release will go into live at some point next week.  Exactly when will largely be determined by the issues users find with the release in Beta.


Major Match Engine Update #1
The Major Match Engine Update #1 scheduled for release into Live at the end of this month is in quite an advanced state and it will be deployed into Beta during this month.


Road Map Updated
We've updated the Road Map to hopefully put ourselves back into position to deliver what we are saying we are going to deliver when we are saying we are going to deliver it.  The updated Roam Map can be found here:
http://90minutefever.com/roadmap/

There has been some guesswork involved here (obviously).  Unfortunately for us, the Billing Issues, whilst we're 'on top' of them, they are very far from resolved.  We still have a lot of work to do here, and there have been a lot of assumptions been made by both Steam and ourselves about how their systems work, hopefully these are all correct, but it has definitely been the case in the past that similar such assumptions about how their systems work have been incorrect.  So here's to hoping!

Changes to the road map are the delay of Player Comparison Tool and Chat Enhancements from End of September to October release.  New Pre-Match Screen from End of October to November.  Also we've added Core Staff System to the End of November release.


Our Apologies
Our sincere apologies here and we can assure you we've been doing our absolute best to deal with the billing issues whilst trying to keep all the rest of the development on track.

We'll continue to do our best to stay on top of things, from our perspective the billing issues (ever since launch), have been nothing short of an absolute nightmare.  We'll be extremely glad when we're able to see the back of them.

Existing beta users are able to fill out this request as well.  It will be possible to have both 90MF Clients (for Live and Beta) open at the same time.

The full release will go into live at some point next week.  Exactly when will largely be determined by the issues users find with the release in Beta.


Major Match Engine Update #1
The Major Match Engine Update #1 scheduled for release into Live at the end of this month is in quite an advanced state and it will be deployed into Beta during this month.


Road Map Updated
We've updated the Road Map to hopefully put ourselves back into position to deliver what we are saying we are going to deliver when we are saying we are going to deliver it.  The updated Roam Map can be found here:
http://90minutefever.com/roadmap/

There has been some guesswork involved here (obviously).  Unfortunately for us, the Billing Issues, whilst we're 'on top' of them, they are very far from resolved.  We still have a lot of work to do here, and there have been a lot of assumptions been made by both Steam and ourselves about how their systems work, hopefully these are all correct, but it has definitely been the case in the past that similar such assumptions about how their systems work have been incorrect.  So here's to hoping!

Changes to the road map are the delay of Player Comparison Tool and Chat Enhancements from End of September to October release.  New Pre-Match Screen from End of October to November.  Also we've added Core Staff System to the End of November release.


Our Apologies
Our sincere apologies here and we can assure you we've been doing our absolute best to deal with the billing issues whilst trying to keep all the rest of the development on track.

We'll continue to do our best to stay on top of things, from our perspective the billing issues (ever since launch), have been nothing short of an absolute nightmare.  We'll be extremely glad when we're able to see the back of them.

notes.title: Road Map
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309476/8d485952f07ab6ed73f31e4ed7b84eb10e06faea.jpg

Please find the most up-to-date version of the road map here:
http://90minutefever.com/roadmap/



Firstly, we are fully aware that it (quite literally) does not matter what our road map says - some people will be disappointed because the features that are most important to them personally do not all appear in the order they want them to appear.  We hope however, that the vast majority of our users will be very happy to know what is coming over the next few months and will eagerly look forward to each monthly release.

Some key points to be aware of:
    We haven't released details of the road map beyond the next few months because we want to factor in the results of the user survey tool coming at the end of this month when putting together the rest of the November release and beyond. 

     Some of these features involve lots of work, require lots of testing, have huge scope to break lots of things and cause lots of bugs, and will need to exist in Beta for an entire season before they can be deployed to live.  The lead time on major match engine updates, and features like Youth Squads and Competitions, is multiple months.  These features are already well into development right now.  Obviously spending development resources working on a feature that will not be deployed into live until months down the track, means we can deliver less features in the short term.

     We know that improving the match simulator and giving users more things to do in the game are of paramount importance.  For the next few months our key priorities are to drastically improve the match engine and implement Youth Squads/Competitions.   The rest of the plan is built around this development work.

     We have a team of people will different skill sets.  Different features require differing amounts of development time from different internal resources, testing time, time required in the Beta World.  All of these things must be factored into our development path.  This will inevitably result in some features appearing in live perhaps sooner than other features that may seem less important.

     We have a long term vision for this game and the develop path needs to build towards this vision over time to ensure it is realised.  

     It is of paramount importance we consistently keep the Live Game World on Steam stable.  This also needs to be built into the development path.

      Lots of priorities exist here and we are being pulled in more directions than anyone could probably imagine.  So we expect that there are likely some features that users will not understand why it is being done when it is not important for them personally, and the answer likely likes in the fact that we have lots of users to take care of (veteran users of different types, new users, and users that will arrive at some point in the future) as well as business/project level priorities as well.

     We have internally discussed at great length whether Youth Squads/Competitions or User Created Competitions should have been developed first.  In the end we went with the Youth but it was a very, very close decision.  We are fully aware how much some users really want this feature.  To be clear this was a huge decision for us, and at a project level for key reasons it is a bad feature to prioritise.  We're spending a huge amount of resources, developing a feature that only a subset of our users (including no new users) will benefit from.  Instead of developing something like User Created Competitions which would have benefited our entire user base.  To fully document all the ins and outs as to the specifics of why this choice was made would require writing a separate forum post that would look more like a thesis.  All I can say is that this was a very close decision for us and we hope that collectively the user base will be happy to see this feature even if they would have preferred to see the User Created Competitions come first.  The reason why this decision could not wait to be decided by user vote via the survey tool coming at the end of this month is because we knew one of these two features had to be in ASAP, and we've already started working on it.

     Whilst we are going to do our best to minimise disruption with the Match Engine updates.  The reality is these updates are huge. Not only do they require major changes to the core engine, but they also are going to empower users with a plethora of tactical options to influence the outcome of matches.  They are fundamentally going to change the very nature of how matches are played out. After each of the major ME updates for sure it is going to require users adapting.  And many users, inevitably, are going to adapt far less well than others and end up winning a lot less after each of these updates than they were before them.  It does not matter how great these updates are for the game, we know there's going to be a subset of the users that end up winning less who are going to be unhappy (explode with rage).  We already have a situation whereby we haven't changed the Match Engine at all during an end of season update, during the close season we have users sell all their senior players and buy a bunch of youth players.  They then proceed to field a team of youth players the following season in senior competitions, and steadfastly believe the reason they are winning less is because we updated the public chat system.  All hands on deck to be fully braced as to what is going to happen when we release these major ME updates that actually do materially change things.

     The road map is not a bona fide guarantee and is subject to change.  We will keep it as up to date as we possibly can.

notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
End of July Release

 Watch Video Showing Key Features

Changes:
 Completely new public chat system
 New Attribute progression widget on Player Profile
 New timeline during matches
 Injury time added during matches
 Minor injuries are now visible on timeline and player statistics
 Fixes and improvements to match commentary
 Team performance added to statistics floating window
 Online status of match participants is now visible
 New columns in Current Auctions Widget: position, age, nationality, reputation
 Swapping for goalkeeper on pitch during match is now possible
 Match view windows are automatically enabled and positioned at default for new users (or existing users playing on new device)
 Kick off buttons before match and 2nd half are blinking
 Http links are now automatically highlighted in both private and public chat
 Possibility to blacklist user in mail, private chat and public chat added
 Information/User-guide moved out of preferences menu into header-bar for more visibility
 Private chat messages are now all aligned to the left hand side instead of one of the user's messages being right aligned

 
 
Fixes:
 Bug potentially able to cause various issues with user-list fixed
 Wikipedia links are now working for players with special characters in names (like Hermann Hreiðarsson)
 Issues with player searchers not saving on new accounts fixed
 Bug causing table editor not applying columns correctly fixed
 Bug causing users sometimes being able to connect to 2 matches at once fixed
 Sorting by time remaining in transfer widgets fixed
 Transfer widgets are now automatically refreshing
 Bug causing "mails from future" to be shown fixed
 Average Mental/Technical/Physical search filters were not returning correct results
 Player Search was returning no results if user added Nationality condition but did not select any Nationality.  Now if user does this the condition will be ignored
 Various bugs with mail message notifications fixed





Update v0.2.1a

1st August 2016

Changes:
 Player Match Rating System minor changes that should result in higher ratings overall on average


Fixes:
 Sometimes public chat not updating
 Slightly improved speed of public chat updates
 Match chat was not always clearing after match completed

notes.title: Pre-Early Access launch users now able to Purchase Monthly Subscriptions
notes.content:
All issues with our Steam store page have now been resolved.  

Our existing beta testers are now also able to purchase monthly subscriptions.  Thank you to all of you for your patience.


If you would like to purchase a monthly subscription please follow these steps:

1. Go to the Store Page for 90MF.
2. Select the subscription package you wish to purchase
3. You'll see a message notifying you that you will only be receiving a subscription and not a 2nd copy of the game. 
4. Click 'Purchase for myself'



We have received an awful lot of messages from our Beta testers who have been playing on Steam and desperately wanting to pay us - we can't begin to express both how much we appreciate this and how inspiring it has been for the whole team!

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.content:
Steam Early Access Launch Build
 
Changes:
 Major match commentary update (Stage 1)
 Complete overhaul of mail message notifications system
 Now able to add characters to chat from the character map using ALT+nnnn notation
 Users are now able to Report accepted transfer bids where they suspect cheating may be involved
 Major performance enhancements to tactics interface (including much faster squad sorting and position diagram changes)
 Images are now cached locally in client (huge performance difference for users with slow internet connections)
 Unavailable players now marked as not being available for selection in the pre-match squad selection screen
 Iceland nation flag added (our tribute to their fantastic Euro's performance!)
 Updated Wikipedia button icon
 Injury and suspended plates changed to white text on red background
 
 
Fixes:
 Flags for countries that are 'unknown' to client are now handled by displaying a '?' flag instead of a flag of a random nation
 Super Friendly League leader-board widgets showing stats from wrong competition
 Match chat showing chat from previous matched fixed
 Match chat not working sometimes
 Chat now uses server time instead of local client time which avoids time synchronisation issues in chat
 Substitutes listed in correct order on performance overlay during match
 Bug causing positions to be missing/unavailable after injury
 Redundant scroll bars removed from player performance widget
 Sometimes player search results didn't display scroll bars when it should have
 Go To Match button appearing when there is no match to go to
 Rare bug which could cause substitutions to not be able to be made during matches
 Rare bug which during match, after a player got a red card, it would not be possible to drag another player to play in the position which the red carded player was previously playing in
 Rare bug which would cause user to see all Transfer Negotiations having Ended status
 

Released 2016-07-09




Update v0.2.0a

Changes:
 Preferences Menu has 'Refer a Friend' button added
 

Fixes:
 Changing size and position of match overlays improved
 Improved sorting behaviour for 'Selected' columns when viewing opponents squad
 Minor fixes to some mail message notifications
 

Released 2016-07-11

notes.title: Update v0.1.14
notes.content:
v0.1.14 [2016-07-08]

Changes:
     Added Wikipedia button to player profile for real players - which will link to that players Wikipedia page
     Loading indicators for widgets
     Player search now informs user if no results have been found
     Added position plates to Lineup tab in the pre-match screen
     Update Penalty commentary
     Tabs with unread messages will have * mark added to the username


Fixes:
     Fixed Flag bug, now shows '?' when no flag is available for players nationality in Client
     Fixed a rare bug where sometimes game client launched in Steam would treat a new user as an existing user
     Fixed bug which caused team instructions and lineup changes during match to 'undo' each other when switching between tabs
     Fix loading positions to lineup and pitch
     Pre-match screen sometimes didn't show changes that you made
     Timeline sometimes showed duplicate event icons during matches
     Phantom substitution icons from previous match 
     Starting another match without leaving Match View doesn't reload Match View
     Fixed a rare bug where Performance Overlay filled with GKs
     Right mouse button sometimes refreshing too slow
     Match overlay settings are not being saved correctly for users
     Lineup and Squad lists had different update rate
     During match, a player sometimes had different positions displayed in Performance Overlay and Lineup
     Fixed a rare bug where players didn't load in Lineup
     Sometimes the performance match overlay displayed incorrect icons
     Fixed a bug where sometimes clicking on Go to Match which incorrectly take user to a match that they previously watched live
     Players on the pitch don't adjust to their proper alignment
     Intelligent selective reload match info in tactics
     Fix Lineup sorting in match
     Fixed a bug where sometimes goals would not show on the timeline
     Empty match window bug fixed
     Stuck outside the game bug fixed
     Previous match substitutions still visible bug fixed
     Fix timers for Emergency and Pause
     Chat refactoring fixing many bugs
     Extract and expand history from chat manager
     "Ghost" system notification pop-ups

     Match simulator sometimes didn't choose correct colours for the teams playing the match

     Fixed a bug where sometimes, before a goal was scored there was a long pause (which is huge spoiler)
     Match has finished, but not button to leave match
     Position codes for central sides were sometimes not correct after a substitution took place
     Combo Boxes in searcher same length
     Substitutions were sometimes not appearing on the match timeline
     Auto-resolve Match crash
     A new chat with the user I've right clicked doesn't open
     Crash after saved formation change
     Posting player links in the Mac client
     Saving position of match chat
     Chat icon is blinking, but clicking does nothing
     Chat icon stopped blinking without being clicked (after >45 minute wait)
     Unable to increase transfer bid when user should be able to in some circumstances
     Transfer bids not showing up on player profile transfer details widget
     Subs are not highlighted in performance floating window
     Cup results would not allow users to hyperlink to club pages
     Stuck in player search
     Searching by Age -> default value
     Man of the match awards value not appearing in Squad view
     Wage should not be visible for auto-accept/reject popup
     GOAL commentary is not flashing after penalty goal
     Timeouts - Match crashed
     Transfer Details Widget bugs
     Replace Transfer List switch in squad with label and fix value
     No players in Mailbox's Find Recipient Box

notes.title: Update v0.1.13
notes.content:
v0.1.13 [2016-07-04]

Changes:
     Fixture pairing system overhauled and should now work correctly pairing you against the opponents in a predictable manner
     Transfer Budget system overhauled, it should now reliably allow you to bid money that you can afford to bid (note: you still cannot forcefully send your team into overdraft)
     Now displays the maximum wage that you would have to pay the player based on the maximum bid amount you have set to offer
     Option to enable/disable name of widget being displayed in the header bar for that widget
     Chat icon is now more noticeable when an unread private chat message is waiting to be read
     Reduced aggression levels for players who have a Yellow Card. This will result in these players picking up a 2nd Yellow Card far less often. 
     Penalties added to match simulator and occurring now with correct frequency
     Knocks (Minor Injuries) added to match simulator
     Various other refinements to Match Rating /10 system. The most noticeable change here will be that GK's should now have a slightly higher average rating overall
     Lots of performance enhancements


Fixes:
     File Browser Works on Mac
     Qualifying League users are now taken to correct divisional standings when clicking on an FA other than the Qualifying FA
     Back and forward functionality now works again with mouse buttons
     Search filters not being saved correctly
     Chat bug where sometimes the time would incorrectly be displayed as 00:00 for a chat message
     Match Log widget was incorrectly showing your own team name instead of Opposition team name for some matches
     '+' button was not working correctly when adjusting Auto Accept amounts (partially fixed in previous release, hopefully fully fixed in this release)
     Various bug fixes relating to colours and information on player positions diagram
     Pitch diagram was being shown with poor image quality
     Viewing previous match results now correctly sorts the players in the player performance overlay
     Match stats and player performance widget are empty when looking at report of previously played match
     Match Statistics widgets coloured bars are not correctly set to middle at beginning of match
     Match sounds now only played for live matches (i.e. they are not played when viewing match report for already played match)
     Fixed phantom icons on timeline appearing from previous match
     Client was crashed when loading previously saved tactics during a match
     Fixed a rare bug where sometimes a user would only have 10 men on the pitch despite not having a player sent off
     Fixed a rare bug that would cause an official fixture to record as a friendly and then attempt to replay that fixture in an infinite loop
     Fixed a bug causing the Reputation Stars sometimes not applying correctly in the search filters
